briefing.headline: US-China compute race intensifies as OpenAI and DeepSeek push frontier model boundaries

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while regulatory pressure mounts on export controls. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing in infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with advanced agentic capabilities; DeepSeek-V3 matched performance at lower cost. Meta open-sourced Llama-4-405B sparking immediate fine-tune activity.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping; Microsoft and Google each broke ground on new 100k GPU clusters. Energy constraints are now the primary bottleneck.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls successfully slow Chinese frontier progress or accelerate domestic alternatives?
